relationships.subject: JAK3
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrate that mutations in JAK3 and STAT5B of the JAK/STAT pathway and inactivation of the oncogene SETD2 markedly contribute to the lymphomagenesis of MEITL.

relationships.subject: STAT5B
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the JAK/STAT pathway is a ubiquitous feature of MEITL.

key_findings: JAK3 mutations found in all three small-intestinal MEITL cases; STAT5B, SETD2 and TP53 mutated in two
MEITL tumors EBER-negative with monoclonal TCR rearrangement
